tools.name: get_features
tools.description: What Ballistic (ballistic.app, a memecoin launch platform) does: launch modes, funding, selling, automations, wallet tools, and what is not available. Each feature says which chains it works on. Read-only.

tools.name: list_launchpads_and_pairs
tools.description: The launchpads Ballistic launches on today, with chain, gas coin, launch modes, who can use them, and what each can be paired with (for example SOL or USDC on pump.fun, a tokenised stock on StonkFun). Includes the live size of the pair lists when they can be read. Read-only.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: The limits Ballistic enforces for one launchpad and pair: how many wallets hold the supply after a launch, holder wallets and each one’s share of supply, wallets in the launch itself, supply range, largest buy, per mode (Block-0 and Reserve). Call list_launchpads_and_pairs first for the launchpad id

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Ballistic’s fee: the rate, when it is charged, what is free, and which costs belong to the chain or the launchpad. Returns the pricing page in full. Read-only.

tools.name: estimate_fee
tools.description: Estimate Ballistic’s platform fee for an amount leaving launch wallets. The fee is on what leaves the wallets, not on trading volume. Gives a figure for Solana and for a stable-coin amount; on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain it gives the rate only. No account is read. Read-only arithmetic.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over Ballistic’s public pages, glossary and documentation. Returns matching sections with their URLs. tools.name: compare_with
tools.description: Compare Ballistic with another token launch tool on fee model, wallets holding supply and wallets in the launch, using what that tool publishes on its own pages, with the date read and the source URLs. Says where Ballistic costs more. Tools covered: proxima, sumo, pumpkit, solbundler, solbundle, smi

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, compare_with · Private data: get_features, compare_with · Public sink: get_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, compare_with · Private data: get_features, compare_with · Public sink: get_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
